purpose: selected diagnostic first-review ablation, not full pipeline or held-out benchmark
controls: Same frozen image/catalogue/initial answer, pinned judge, seed42, unchanged budgets and gate; rotate arms. No extra review rounds. Labels/references post-prediction only.
hypotheses: Source byte preservation does not guarantee semantic scope preservation.
Duplicate status fields cause model inconsistencies.
Protocol identifier mismatch blocks canonical decisions independently of semantics.
Concise claimed-versus-observed comparison may reduce direction and scope errors.
promotion: Require more joint correct-label/adequate-explanation results without added harmful flips or lost sound baseline corrections; then pass reserve. Otherwise retain defaults.
limits: Paired changes both prompt wording and field order; effects cannot be attributed separately. Provisional prior semantic screening is not independent human annotation.
